visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person walks into a dimly lit, blurred indoor space with white pillars; technical overlays appear briefly. (2) A close-up shot of a large red promotional banner featuring the 'Nintendo Switch 2' logo and a controller graphic. (3) A steady shot of an event directory map on a stand, showing locations for various Nintendo games like Zelda and Metroid. (4) A screen recording sequence of a mobile phone interface showing the LINE app and a web-based reservation system with QR codes. (5) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light pink cardigan and white top, stands in front of a giant gray console graphic, speaking enthusiastically with wide hand gestures. (6) Montage of people playing games in a bright exhibition hall; a screen displays 'Super Mario Party' gameplay while players jump. (7) The woman sits at a white desk playing a racing game with a Joy-Con and a computer mouse, laughing and reacting to the screen. (8) Detailed shots of 'Metroid Prime 4 Beyond' posters and the woman interacting with staff members in red shirts while holding gaming peripherals. (9) Final sequence of the woman back in front of the console background, smiling and pointing toward the camera lens.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Switch 2 體驗會來啦. (2) [Logo]: Nintendo Switch 2. (3) [Subtitle]: 大家記得走這個 1 號出口. [Variety]: 薩爾達耶. 可以玩薩爾達耶. 好玩了. 喔好興奮. (4) [Logo]: 台灣任天堂活動小組. [Slogan]: Group A-F. [Subtitle]: 除了瑪利歐賽車是所有參加者都能體驗之外. 會場內其他遊戲都需要從官方 LINE 帳號領取體驗券. 大家可以先掃這個 QR code 加入好友喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們今天的體驗會. 竟然不知不覺花了兩個小時. 而且還沒有全部玩完喔. 那我們就在有限的時間. 推薦給大家三個一定要玩到的遊戲. 哪三個. (6) [Subtitle]: 首先是《瑪利歐派對 空前盛會》. 真的拜託一定要玩. 那個互動感真的很夠. 是體感跟滑鼠都要玩嗎. 真的都要. 就是中間那一個區塊啦. 真的都一定要玩. (7) [Slogan]: DRAG X DRIVE. [Subtitle]: 那第二個勒. 第二個的話是那個《DD》. 他是. 你說你很雷 打籃球的那一個嗎. 對對對. 就可以那個 那是什麼. 輪椅的那一個. 輪椅投籃的. 那真的很搞笑. 而且會有真人跟你做對戰. 然后我就覺得真的是很刺激. 然后因為我很雷. 所以我覺得很好笑. (8) [Subtitle]: 確實蠻搞笑的. 對不起. 那第三個勒. 第三十個就是那個. (9) [Slogan]: METROID PRIME 4 BEYOND. [Subtitle]: 《密特羅德》. 他是那種射擊遊戲. 雖然我一開始很不擅長. 可是我覺得這裡面的那個工作人員都很細心的在教導. 還會給你很多情緒價值. (10) [Subtitle]: 大家可以完全體驗到. 就是 Switch 2 滑鼠的那個功能. 那個滑鼠真的是非常的絲滑. 很靈敏很好用. 有機會來體驗的大家. 千萬不要錯過. 要玩的開心喔.
